1.word_for_word: द्व्य्-अशीतितम आगत्य कुरु-क्षेत्रं रवि-ग्रहे । — On the eighty-second day, he arrived at the Kuru-kshetra in the planet Sun.; वृष्णीन् दृष्ट्वा मुदा भूपाश् चक्रुः कृष्ण-कथा मिथः ॥ — Seeing the Vṛṣṇis, the kings happily conversed with one another about Lord Kṛṣṇa.; श्री-दाम-सुहृदे कृष्णः प्रकल्प्यैन्द्रं पदं भुवि । — Lord Kṛṣṇa, the friend of Śrī-Dāma, decided to take His abode on earth as Indra.; : सुदाम-सुहृदे इति पाठः। — The text is in the friend of Sudama.; नन्दादि-सुहृदानन्दी कुरु-क्षेत्रं जगाम सः ॥ — Delighted with his friends Nanda and others, he went to the Kuru region.; कल्प-क्षये यथा सर्व-ग्रास इत्य् अर्थः ॥१॥ — This means that at the end of a kalpa, as in the consumption of all.
1.translation: On the eighty-second day, he arrived at the Kuru-kshetra in the planet Sun. Seeing the Vṛṣṇis, the kings happily conversed with one another about Lord Kṛṣṇa. Lord Kṛṣṇa, the friend of Śrī-Dāma, decided to take His abode on earth as Indra. The text is in the friend of Sudama. Delighted with his friends Nanda and others, he went to the Kuru region. This means that at the end of a kalpa, as in the consumption of all.

2.word_for_word: ज्योतिर्-विद्भिः कथ्यमानम् आदाव् एव ज्ञात्वा । — Knowing from the beginning what the astrologers say.; स्यमन्त-पञ्चकं क्षेत्रं कुरु-क्षेत्रम् ॥२॥ — The five fields of Syamanta are the fields of the Kurus.
2.translation: Knowing from the beginning what the astrologers say. The five fields of Syamanta are the fields of the Kurus.

3.word_for_word: अब्रह्मण्य् अक्षत्रिय-वध-स्थानत्वेन परशुरामस्याघापनुत्ति-स्थानत्वेन च क्षेत्रस्य पाप-निरासकत्वम् आह---निःक्षत्रियाम् इति द्वाभ्याम् ॥३॥ — He argues that the field is the place of killing the kshatriyas in the absence of the Brahman and the place of the remission of the sins of Parasurama and that the field is the destroyer of sins, by saying that it is without kshatriyas in two ways.
3.translation: He argues that the field is the place of killing the kshatriyas in the absence of the Brahman and the place of the remission of the sins of Parasurama and that the field is the destroyer of sins, by saying that it is without kshatriyas in two ways.

4.word_for_word: अन्यो विद्वन् यथा ॥४॥ — as another learned man.

5-6.word_for_word: आगन्न् आजग्मुः भारतीर् भारत्यः ॥५॥ — The Indians came and the Indians came.
5-6.translation: The Indians came and the Indians came.

7-8.word_for_word: सुचन्द्र-शुक-सारणैः सहानिरुद्धो द्वारका-रक्षायाम् आस्ते । — Along with Suchandra, Shuka and Sarana, Aniruddha is guarding Dwarka.; तथा कृत-वर्मा च यूथ-पतिः सेनानीः । — Similarly, Krita-varma, the commander of the youth, was a fighter.; देव-धिष्ण्याभैर् विमान-सङ्काशैः । — They resembled the seats of the gods and resembled airplanes.; तरलास् तरङ्गास् तद्वत् प्लवो गतिर् येषां तैः ॥७॥ — The waves are like the waves of the float by those whose movement is like that of the float.; विद्याधर-द्युभिर् विद्याधराणाम् इव द्युतिर् येषां तैः । — They have the brightness of the Vidyādharas, whose brightness is like that of the Vidyādharas.; महा-तेजा महा---तेजसः ॥८॥ — Maha-teja maha---tejasaḥ.
7-8.translation: Along with Suchandra, Shuka and Sarana, Aniruddha is guarding Dwarka. Similarly, Krita-varma, the commander of the youth, was a fighter. They resembled the seats of the gods and resembled airplanes. The waves are like the waves of the float by those whose movement is like that of the float. They have the brightness of the Vidyādharas, whose brightness is like that of the Vidyādharas. Maha-teja maha---tejasaḥ.

9-10.word_for_word: दिव्या अत्युत्तमाः स्रग् वस्त्र-सन्नाहा येषाम् ॥९॥ — They were adorned with divine and excellent garlands and clothes.; पुनर् अन्येद्युर् आप्लुत्य । — Again, the next day, he jumped.; यद् वा, तस्मिन्न् एवाहनि मुक्ति-स्नानं कृत्वा ॥१०॥ — Or, on that very day, having taken the bath of liberation.
9-10.translation: They were adorned with divine and excellent garlands and clothes. Again, the next day, he jumped. Or, on that very day, having taken the bath of liberation.

11-12.word_for_word: स्निग्धा शीतला छाया येषाम् अङ्घ्रि-पानाम् अङ्घ्रिषु मूलेषु ॥१२॥ — The shadow of those whose feet are smooth and cool is at the roots of their feet.
11-12.translation: The shadow of those whose feet are smooth and cool is at the roots of their feet.

15.word_for_word: प्रोत्फुल्लैर् हृद्-हृद्वक्त्र-सरोरुहैः श्री-ः शोभा येषां ते ॥१५॥ — They are the beauty of those whose hearts, hearts, faces and lotuses are blossoming.
15.translation: They are the beauty of those whose hearts, hearts, faces and lotuses are blossoming.

16.word_for_word: अतिसौहृदेन यत् स्मितं तेनामला अपाङ्गैर् दृशो दृष्टयो यासां ताः । — The smile of a very friendly person is the one whose eyes are pure and whose eyes are visible to the disabled.; मिथः परस्परं संवीक्ष्य दोर्भिर् अभिरेभिरे आलिङ्गनं कृतवत्यः ॥१६॥ — They looked at each other and embraced each other with their arms around them.
16.translation: The smile of a very friendly person is the one whose eyes are pure and whose eyes are visible to the disabled. They looked at each other and embraced each other with their arms around them.

18.word_for_word: सङ्कथया मिथः स-प्रेम-गोष्ठ्या ॥१८॥ — By talking to each other and by talking about love.
18.translation: By talking to each other and by talking about love.

19.word_for_word: ताम् एव वसुदेव-पृथयोः सङ्कथाम् आह---आर्येत्य्-आदि चतुर्भिः । — He relates the same story of Vasudeva and Pṛtha in four words, beginning with Arya.; अकृताशिषम् अपूर्ण-मनोरथम् ॥१९॥ — Unfulfilled wishes and unfulfilled desires.
19.translation: He relates the same story of Vasudeva and Pṛtha in four words, beginning with Arya. Unfulfilled wishes and unfulfilled desires.

20.word_for_word: यस्य दैवम् अदक्षिणम् अननुकूलं तं स्व-जनम् अपि सन्तं सुहृदादयो नानुस्मरन्ति । — A person whose fate is unfavorable to him is not remembered by his relatives, friends or others.; अतो मम दैवं प्रतिकूलं, युष्माकं कोऽपराध इति भावः ॥२०॥ — Therefore my destiny is adverse, and what is your fault?
20.translation: A person whose fate is unfavorable to him is not remembered by his relatives, friends or others. Therefore my destiny is adverse, and what is your fault?

22.word_for_word: ईश-वशत्वम् एवाह---कंस-प्रतापिता इति । — He said that it was the subjection of God that was tormented by Kansa.; हे स्वसः ! — O Swasah!; एतर्ह्य् एव संप्रत्य् एव ॥२२॥ — This is the very present.
22.translation: He said that it was the subjection of God that was tormented by Kansa. O Swasah! This is the very present.

27.word_for_word: युधिष्ठिरं येऽनुव्रतास् ते, राजसूये जितत्वात् ॥२७॥ — Those who followed Yudhisthira, having won the Rajasuya.
27.translation: Those who followed Yudhisthira, having won the Rajasuya.

29.word_for_word: जन्म-भाजो नृणां मध्ये स-फल-जन्मानः ॥२९॥ — He is the recipient of birth among men and is born with the fruits.
29.translation: He is the recipient of birth among men and is born with the fruits.

30.word_for_word: किं च, न केवलं तस्य दर्शनम् एव, अपि तु अत्यन्त-दुर्लभं बहु युष्माकं स्वतः संपन्नम् इत्य् आहुः---यद् विश्रुतिर् इति द्वाभ्याम् । — Moreover, they say that not only is it the sight of Him, but that many of you who are very rare have attained it by yourselves, namely, fame and fortune.; यद् इति पृथक् पदम् । — Yad is a separate term.; यस्येत्य् अर्थः। — whose, that is, whose.; विश्रुतिः कीर्तिः श्रुतिभिर् नुता वेदैः स्तुता इदं विश्वम् अलम् अत्य्-अर्थं पुनाति । — Fame, fame, bowed down by the scriptures and praised by the Vedas purify this universe in a very meaningful way.; यद् विश्रुति-श्रुतिर् अमीवम् अलम् इति पाठे श्रुतिः श्रवणम् अमीवं पापम् इति । — That which is heard in the text, 'Amivam alam', is heard, 'Amivam papam'; यस्य पादाव् अनेजन-पयो गङ्गा च यस्य वचो वाक्य-रूपं शास्त्रं च वेदाख्यं विश्वं पुनाति । — At His feet are the milk of the Ganges, and His words, in the form of speech and scriptures, purify the universe called the Vedas.; किं च, कालेन भर्जितं दग्धं भगं माहात्म्यं यस्याः, सा तथा-विधापि भूर्य् अस्याङ्घ्रि-पद्म-स्पर्शेनोत्था आविर्भूता शक्तिर् यस्याः सा । — Moreover, the greatness of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, whose glory has been burnt by time, is the same as the power of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, whose power has been revealed by the touch of His lotus feet.; नोऽस्माकम् अखिलान् अर्थान् अभितो वर्षति ॥३०॥ — It showers us all our wealth from all sides.
30.translation: Moreover, they say that not only is it the sight of Him, but that many of you who are very rare have attained it by yourselves, namely, fame and fortune. Yad is a separate term. whose, that is, whose. Fame, fame, bowed down by the scriptures and praised by the Vedas purify this universe in a very meaningful way. That which is heard in the text, 'Amivam alam', is heard, 'Amivam papam' At His feet are the milk of the Ganges, and His words, in the form of speech and scriptures, purify the universe called the Vedas. Moreover, the greatness of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, whose glory has been burnt by time, is the same as the power of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, whose power has been revealed by the touch of His lotus feet. It showers us all our wealth from all sides.

31.word_for_word: दर्शनं च, स्पर्शनं चानुपथोऽनुगतिश् च, प्रजल्पो गोष्ठी च, शय्या शयनं च, आसनं च, अशनं भोजनं च, यौनं विवाह--सम्बन्धस् तेन सह वर्तमानः स-पिण्ड-बन्धो दैहिक-सम्बन्धः, तेन श्री-कृष्णेन सह दर्शनाद्य्-उपलक्षितः स-यौनः स-पिण्ड-बन्धो येषां वोऽस्ति । — Seeing, touching, following, talking, talking, lying down, sitting, eating, eating, sexual intercourse, marriage, the physical relationship with Him, the sexual relationship with Him, which is manifested by seeing and other things with Lord Krishna.; किं च, येषां वो गृहे विष्णुः स्वयम् आस आविरभूत् । — Moreover, Lord Viṣṇu Himself appeared in your house.; निरय-वर्त्मनि प्रवृत्ति-मार्गे वर्तमानानां स्वर्गापवर्गाभ्यां विरमयति वितृष्णान् करोतीति तथा सः । — He thus distracts those who are on the path of instinct from the path of hell from heaven and liberation.; ते यूयं जन्म-भाज इति । — They say you are the birth-vessel.; यद् वा, तद् इति सामान्य-निर्देशः । — or whatever, that is the general indication.; स इत्य्-अर्थः । — That means it.; स विष्णुः स्वयं येषां वो निरय-वर्त्मनि संसार-कारणे गृहे वर्तमानानाम् अपि बध्यते सम्बन्ध्यत इति बन्धो दर्शनादिभिः सम्बद्धः सन् स्वर्गापवर्ग-विरम आस । — That Vishnu Himself, who is bound and related to those of you who are on the path of hell and who are at home for the sake of this world, was connected with the bondage of seeing and other things and was the cessation of heavenly liberation.; परम-सुख-प्रदो बभूवेत्य् अर्थः ॥३१॥ — This means that he became the giver of supreme happiness.
31.translation: Seeing, touching, following, talking, talking, lying down, sitting, eating, eating, sexual intercourse, marriage, the physical relationship with Him, the sexual relationship with Him, which is manifested by seeing and other things with Lord Krishna. Moreover, Lord Viṣṇu Himself appeared in your house. He thus distracts those who are on the path of instinct from the path of hell from heaven and liberation. They say you are the birth-vessel. or whatever, that is the general indication. That means it. That Vishnu Himself, who is bound and related to those of you who are on the path of hell and who are at home for the sake of this world, was connected with the bondage of seeing and other things and was the cessation of heavenly liberation. This means that he became the giver of supreme happiness.

32.word_for_word: अनः-स्थार्थैर् इति । — Anah-sthaarthair iti.; तत्रैव वास-चिकीर्षया शकटेषु स्थापितैर् अर्थैः सहागत इत्य् अर्थः ॥३२॥ — This means that he came there with the wealth placed in the carts with the intention of staying there.
32.translation: Anah-sthaarthair iti. This means that he came there with the wealth placed in the carts with the intention of staying there.

34.word_for_word: वसुदेवस् तं परिष्वज्य प्रेम-विह्वलो बभूवेति शेषः ॥३४॥ — Vasudeva embraced him and became overwhelmed with love, the rest.
34.translation: Vasudeva embraced him and became overwhelmed with love, the rest.

38.word_for_word: अनिवृत्तां निवृत्ति-कारणे सत्य् अप्य् अनुवर्तमानाम् । — They are not restrained, and they follow the truth for the sake of renunciation.; ऐन्द्रम् ऐश्वर्यं प्राप्यापि यस्याः प्रतिक्रिया कर्तुं न शक्यत इत्य् अर्थः ॥३८॥ — This means that even after obtaining the opulence of Indra it is impossible to respond to her.
38.translation: They are not restrained, and they follow the truth for the sake of renunciation. This means that even after obtaining the opulence of Indra it is impossible to respond to her.

39.word_for_word: तत्-कृतां मैत्रीम् आहतुः---एताव् इति । — They called the friendship that he had made: Etaw.; न दृष्टौ पितरौ याभ्याः तौ । — They have not seen their fathers.; वस्तुतस् तु अजन्मत्वाद् एवादृष्ट-पितरौ । — In fact, the two fathers were unseen because they were unborn.; हे भवति, युवयोः पित्रोर् न्यस्ताव् एतौ संप्रीणनादीनि प्राप्याकुत्र च भयौ क्वचिद् अपि भय-रहितौ भूत्वोषतुर् वासं चक्रतुः । — O yes, these two men, who were entrusted to you by your fathers, have received these satisfactions and other things, and have lived here without fear, and sometimes without fear.; कथं भूतयोः । — How about the two ghosts.; अक्ष्णोर् नेत्रयो रक्षकं पक्ष्म यद्वत्तया रक्षकयोः युक्तं युवयोर् एतत् । — The eyelids are the protectors of the eyes, and this is the protector of the two of you.; यतः सतां परः स्व इति नास्ति वैषम्यम् ॥३९॥ — Because there is no difference between the Supreme and the Self of the virtuous.
39.translation: They called the friendship that he had made: Etaw. They have not seen their fathers. In fact, the two fathers were unseen because they were unborn. O yes, these two men, who were entrusted to you by your fathers, have received these satisfactions and other things, and have lived here without fear, and sometimes without fear. How about the two ghosts. The eyelids are the protectors of the eyes, and this is the protector of the two of you. Because there is no difference between the Supreme and the Self of the virtuous.

40.word_for_word: अभीष्टत्वे लिङ्गम्, यद् यस्य श्री-कृष्णस्य प्रेक्षणे दृशिषु नेत्रेषु व्यवधायकं पक्ष्म-कृतं विधातारं शपन्ति । — Lingam in its desirability, that is, when one sees Lord Kṛṣṇa, one curses the creator, whose eyelids are interrupted by the eyes of the sighted.; दृग्भिर् नेत्र-द्वारैर् हृदि कृतं हृदये प्रवेशितं परिरभ्य तद् भावं तद् आत्मतां प्रापुः । — They embraced the feeling that had been created in their hearts through the gates of their eyes and attained that feeling of self-realization.; अपि नित्य-युजाम् आरूढ-योगिनाम् अपि ॥४०॥ — Even the daily yogis who have ascended the yogis.
40.translation: Lingam in its desirability, that is, when one sees Lord Kṛṣṇa, one curses the creator, whose eyelids are interrupted by the eyes of the sighted. They embraced the feeling that had been created in their hearts through the gates of their eyes and attained that feeling of self-realization. Even the daily yogis who have ascended the yogis.

42.word_for_word: चिरायितान् विलम्बितान् । — They’ve been delayed for a long time.; अत्र हेतुः---शत्रूणां पक्षस्य क्षपणे चेतो येषां तान् ॥४२॥ — The reason for this is that those whose minds are set on destroying the party of the enemy.
42.translation: They’ve been delayed for a long time. The reason for this is that those whose minds are set on destroying the party of the enemy.

43.word_for_word: अपि स्वित् अस्मान् अवध्यायथावजानीथ । — Do you understand us as if we were immortal?; अकृत-ज्ञा एत इत्य् अविशङ्कया ईषच्-छङ्कया न शङ्का-मात्रं, निश्चितम् एवैतत् परित्यज्य गतत्वाद् इत्य् अत आह---नूनम् इति ॥४३॥ — Without doubt, with a little doubt, that this is an ignorant person, it is not merely doubt, but certainly because he has abandoned this and gone away. Therefore he argues, "Surely.
43.translation: Do you understand us as if we were immortal? Without doubt, with a little doubt, that this is an ignorant person, it is not merely doubt, but certainly because he has abandoned this and gone away. Therefore he argues, "Surely.

44.word_for_word: एतत् स-दृष्टान्तम् आह---वायुर् इति । — This is the same illustration he gives: the wind.; आक्षिपते पृथक् करोतीत्य् अर्थः ॥४४॥ — This means that it attracts and separates.
44.translation: This is the same illustration he gives: the wind. This means that it attracts and separates.

45.word_for_word: अपि च अति-भद्रम् इदं यद् उत भवतीनां मद्-वियोगेन मत्-प्रेमाति-शयोजात इत्य् आह---मयीति । — Moreover, it is very good that you have fallen in love with Me because of your separation from Me.; मयि भक्ति-मात्रम् एव तावद् अमृतत्वाय कल्पत इति । — Only devotion to Me is sufficient for immortality.; यद् उत भवतीनां मत्-स्नेह आसीत् तद् दिष्ट्याति-भद्रम् । — Fortunately, the affection you had for me was very good.; कुतः ? — Where is it from?; मद्-आपनो मत्-प्रापण इति ॥४४॥ — Mad-apano Mat-prapana, to attain Me.
45.translation: Moreover, it is very good that you have fallen in love with Me because of your separation from Me. Only devotion to Me is sufficient for immortality. Fortunately, the affection you had for me was very good. Where is it from? Mad-apano Mat-prapana, to attain Me.

46.word_for_word: कीदृशस् त्वं यं वयं स्नेहेन प्राप्स्यामः ? — What kind of you are we to love?; इत्य् अपेक्षायाम् आत्म-स्वरूपम् आह---अहं हीति । — In expectation of this, he argues for the Self-form: I am.; हे अङ्गनाः ! — O courtyards!; भौतिकानां शराव-सैन्धवादीनां यथाकाशादीनि पञ्च-महा-भूतान्य् आद्य्-अन्तादि-रूपाणि, एवं सर्व-भूतानां जरायुजादीनाम् अहम् । — Just as the five great elements, such as the sky and the ocean, are the beginning and end of the material world, so I am the source of all living entities, such as old age and old age.; अतो व्यापकं मां भवत्यः प्राप्ता एवेति ॥४६॥ — Therefore you have already attained Me, the pervasive.
46.translation: What kind of you are we to love? In expectation of this, he argues for the Self-form: I am. O courtyards! Just as the five great elements, such as the sky and the ocean, are the beginning and end of the material world, so I am the source of all living entities, such as old age and old age. Therefore you have already attained Me, the pervasive.

47.word_for_word: ननु चतुर्-विध-भूत-ग्रामाणां तद्-भोक्ता आत्मैवाद्य्-अन्तादि-रूपः, तस्मिंश् च सर्व-व्यापके सर्व-भूतानि वर्तन्त इति कुतस् त्वत्-प्राप्तिर् अस्माकम् ? — If, indeed, the enjoyer of the four kinds of beings is the Self, the form of the beginning and the end, and in that all-pervading all beings dwell, where is our attainment of You?; इत्य् अत आह---एवं हीति । — It is therefore argued that it is so.; अयम् अर्थः---शरावादीनां यथा भौतिकानां महा-भूतान्य् आद्य्-अन्तादि-रूपाणि, एवम् एवैतानि चतुर्-विधानि भूतान्य् अपि भौतिकत्वाविशेषात् स्व-कारणेषु भूतेष्व् एव वर्तन्ते, न तु भोक्तर्य् आत्मनि । — This means that just as the great beings of the physical beings, such as the arrows, have the forms of beginning and end, so these four kinds of beings, because of their special physical nature, exist in beings in their own causes, not in the enjoyer himself.; आत्मा तु तेषु भूतेष्व् आत्मना भोक्तृ-रूपेण ततो व्याप्तो न कारणत्वेन । — The soul, however, pervades those beings by itself as the enjoyer, not as the cause.; अथ एतद् उभयं भूत-भौतिक-रूपं भोग्यं च भोक्तारं चात्मानं मय्य् अक्षरे परिपूर्णे आभातं पश्यतेति ॥४७॥ — Then he sees both this form of being and matter, the enjoyable and the enjoyer, as reflected in Me, the imperishable, the perfect.
47.translation: If, indeed, the enjoyer of the four kinds of beings is the Self, the form of the beginning and the end, and in that all-pervading all beings dwell, where is our attainment of You? It is therefore argued that it is so. This means that just as the great beings of the physical beings, such as the arrows, have the forms of beginning and end, so these four kinds of beings, because of their special physical nature, exist in beings in their own causes, not in the enjoyer himself. The soul, however, pervades those beings by itself as the enjoyer, not as the cause. Then he sees both this form of being and matter, the enjoyable and the enjoyer, as reflected in Me, the imperishable, the perfect.

48.word_for_word: अध्यात्म-शिक्षया स्वरूपोपदेशेन शिक्षिता बोधिताः, तस्यानुस्मरणेन ध्वस्तो जीव-कोशो लिङ्गं यासां तास् तम् एवाध्यगन् प्रापुः ॥४८॥ — Having been taught by the teachings of the Self and enlightened by the instruction of the Self, those whose cells of life were destroyed by remembrance of Him attained to Him alone.
48.translation: Having been taught by the teachings of the Self and enlightened by the instruction of the Self, those whose cells of life were destroyed by remembrance of Him attained to Him alone.

49.word_for_word: एवं प्राप्तोऽपि कृष्णः पुनर् गृह-व्यासङ्गेन मापयात्व् इति तच् चरण-स्मरणं प्रार्थयाम् आसुर् इत्य् आह---आहुश् चेति । — Even after receiving this, I prayed to Kṛṣṇa to remember His feet again, saying, “Let me measure you again by the attachment of the house.”; हे नलिन-नाभ ! — O lotus-navel!; ते पदारविन्दं गेहं जुषां गृह-सेविनीनाम् अपि नो मनसि सदा उदियाद् आविर्भवेत् ॥४९॥ — May the lotus feet of Your house always appear in our minds even as housewives who are devoted to their homes.
49.translation: Even after receiving this, I prayed to Kṛṣṇa to remember His feet again, saying, “Let me measure you again by the attachment of the house.” O lotus-navel! May the lotus feet of Your house always appear in our minds even as housewives who are devoted to their homes.
